sloka: प्रयाताः च आर्य सम्घाता रामम् द्रष्टुम् सलक्ष्मणम् ।तस्य एव च कथाः चित्राः कुर्वाणा हृष्ट मानसाः ॥२-८३-७॥
transliteration: prayātāḥ ca ārya samghātā rāmam draṣṭum salakṣmaṇam ।tasya eva ca kathāḥ citrāḥ kurvāṇā hṛṣṭa mānasāḥ ॥2-83-7॥

translations.english: Venerable people in groups, narrating various accomplishments of Rama and eager to see him with Lakshmana, proceeded in a delightful mood.
